text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, do you have a minute? —Yep! 
Just like that spark told me!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Look, this trilby hat! The silhouette is 
elegant, but the fabric and color scheme 
give it a playful, cute charm, don't they? 
♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
When I saw it the other day, I just knew 
it would look amazing on you, Trainer! So 
I saved it to my bookmarks♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to see what it looks like on you 
in person, too... Would you like to go 
check out the physical store together 
sometime?♪
